A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same situated-faithfulness study despite the revised title. Their main text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices support reliable comparison, including matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: v1 reports original QA evaluations, CR-DPO training results, ablations, calibration experiments, and context-style robustness tests.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds ActiveRAG comparisons, confidence-calibration measurements, and threshold-sensitivity results.

M1.justification: SCR, RCR, and CR-DPO retain their inference procedures, preference-pair construction, and training objectives. Appendix A.2 newly documents reasoning-trace filtering, but does not establish that the underlying procedure changed between versions.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same six QA datasets and retain the same training domains and RedditQA context-style tests. Long-form QA and multiple retrieved contexts are discussed only as future work in v2, not evaluated.

E2.justification: v2 adds ActiveRAG to the GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o comparisons across all six datasets in Table 6. The existing comparator sets are otherwise retained; the changed labels in the robustness table do not identify new methods.

E3.justification: Appendices D.2–D.3 add ECE/AUC-ROC evaluation and an InternalConf threshold sweep from 0 to 1. Appendix A.1 also reverses its FreshQA filtering wording, but contradicts its later description; this is a reported preprocessing inconsistency, not evidence that a different subset was actually evaluated.

E4.justification: v2 adds targeted diagnostics of internal versus contextual confidence calibration across models and datasets (Table 7), and task-dependent threshold sensitivity for GPT-4o-mini (Figure 3). Existing CR-DPO ablations, InternalEval fine-tuning, question-order analysis, and context-style robustness tests are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports experimental seeds, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The robustness table retains identical summaries of variation across context styles. The new ECE/AUC-ROC results assess model confidence rather than uncertainty in experimental estimates.

E6.justification: Retained accuracy, ablation, and robustness results are numerically unchanged. v2 newly reports ActiveRAG overall scores of 66.4 for GPT-4o-mini and 74.0 for GPT-4o (Table 6), calibration measurements (Table 7), and threshold-response curves (Figure 3). These supplement existing findings rather than show revision-to-revision performance gains.

T1.justification: Section 3.1 removes the explicit conditional objective for answering correctly when both internal knowledge and external context give incorrect answers, leaving three enumerated cases. The correctness definitions, situated-faithfulness metric, and stated upper bounds remain unchanged; no proofs are added.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: situated-faithfulness evaluation, RedditQA, SCR/RCR, and CR-DPO. The central comparative claims and headline improvements of 24.2% and 8.9% remain unchanged; stronger knowledge-conflict wording does not redefine their scientific scope.

C2.justification: New Appendix G gives practical guidance on choosing implicit versus explicit SCR and identifies limits involving long-form answers, multiple conflicting contexts, and CoT inference cost. Appendix D.3 also interprets task-dependent optimal thresholds as a limitation of RCR. Earlier mechanism explanations are largely retained.

D1.justification: v2 identifies the ClaimBuster model and documents reasoning-trace filtering, including the recall threshold and 375 rejected paths out of 17,895. Conversely, it removes the closed-book and completely context-faithful prompt templates from v1 Appendices F.1 and F.3. Training hyperparameters and code/data access locations remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v2 adds positioning against ActiveRAG, RobustRAG, source-critical reasoning, and credibility-aware generation, while removing citations to Jin, Tan, and Xu. The AstuteRAG and KnowPO discussion is retained in Appendix F. These are focused extensions of the existing research positioning.

P1.justification: v2 revises the title and selected abstract, introduction, and method passages; moves part of related work into Appendix F; adds Discussion and Replication sections; and reorganizes appendix labels. The main narrative and most existing prose remain intact.

P2.justification: v2 adds calibration Table 7 and threshold Figure 3, expands Table 6, and repositions or resizes existing displays. Figures 1–2 retain identical artwork. The robustness table uses inconsistent RSCR/CRPO labels, and the ExplicitSCR example box on page 21 extends into the footer and page boundary.

improvement.justification: The added ActiveRAG comparison and calibration/threshold diagnostics strengthen evidence for the existing RCR analysis, while Appendix G makes practical choices and applicability limits clearer. These provide a limited net improvement. Removing two prompt templates, inconsistent FreshQA filtering descriptions, and localized layout defects temper the gains in documentation and presentation.
